platform: KRFC 88.9 FM Public Upload Form and Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KRFC's official form requires release metadata, a streaming link, an MP3 or WAV upload and a one-sheet upload, and it includes a hidden validation/honeypot field that must not be manipulated. A human must verify clean FCC-safe edits and rights, prepare the metadata and files, complete the public form normally or choose the physical-CD route, and avoid duplicate delivery.

platform: Radio Boise KRBX Public Dynamic Music Submission Form Route
manual_review_reason: Radio Boise explicitly routes artists to its official Submit Your Music page, but the embedded form loads dynamically and its current fields, file/link rules, declarations and any runtime human-verification controls are not exposed in the static page. A human must inspect and complete the live form normally, confirm all requirements and avoid using the general station email as a substitute submission route.

platform: WNCW 88.7 Music Director Digital and Physical Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WNCW prefers mailed CDs but also accepts digital WAV or MP3 delivery to the publicly listed Music Director address through a common downloadable service such as Dropbox or Google Drive. A human must choose one route, prepare a concise one-sheet, verify release rights and file accessibility, select focus material and handle any physical shipping; airplay is not guaranteed.

platform: KZMU Moab Public Music and Programming Director Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: KZMU publicly lists its Music and Programming Director and business email, but the current official site does not publish an unsolicited-music submission policy, accepted formats, attachment or download-link rules, release windows or required metadata. A human must first send only a concise routing inquiry without audio files or track links and wait for explicit authorization and delivery instructions.
